look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson four
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 1, lesson T04, What does an exchange do; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: The meeting place
scenes.desc: Exchange and trading platform defined: buyers and sellers flow into one marketplace that records trades.

scenes.name: An order
scenes.desc: Order defined: a buy ticket for 0.01 BTC at 60,000 USDT builds field by field, 600 USDT in total.

scenes.name: The order book
scenes.desc: Order book defined: sell orders stack above, buy orders below, sorted by price, changing all the time.

scenes.name: Bid and ask
scenes.desc: Bid and ask defined: best bid 59,990 and best ask 60,010 are highlighted.

scenes.name: Spread
scenes.desc: Spread = ask minus bid: 20 USDT, then a new 60,000 bid narrows it to 10; quiet markets have wider spreads.

scenes.name: Matching
scenes.desc: A buy of 0.30 BTC up to 60,020 fills 0.20 at 60,010 and 0.10 at 60,020: 18,004 USDT; last price 60,020.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and match: 0.10 BTC up to 60,015 fills 0.05 at 60,010 and 0.05 at 60,015, 6,001.25 USDT in total.

scenes.name: One example
scenes.desc: Binance is one large exchange among many; course screens are generic educational mocks.

scenes.name: Not a bank
scenes.desc: An exchange is not a bank: usually no deposit protection; withdrawals can pause, hacks, closures; rules differ.

scenes.name: Spot the fake
scenes.desc: Phishing defined; a fake message's red flags (urgency, look-alike address, asks for OTP) versus safe habits.

scenes.name: Never share these
scenes.desc: Account security: never share password, OTP or API secret key; support never asks; turn on 2FA.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: Phase 1 complete; next, CP1 Foundations Checkpoint.
